findings.errorHandlingFlow: Generic error catch in ApiConfig.tsx line 163 shows 'Failed to configure API' without specific error details. Try-catch blocks exist but error messages are not granular enough for debugging.
findings.validationLogic: API configuration validation occurs in validateApiKey() function (lines 121-125) and checks for sk- prefix and minimum length, but JWT generation and backend connectivity validation happens separately.
findings.userFeedback: Error display mechanism uses browser alert() at line 163, which provides limited debugging information. No structured error state management for displaying detailed errors to users.
findings.asyncIssues: Multiple async JWT generation calls in useEffect and handleSaveConfiguration could cause race conditions. JWT generation in lines 76, 103, and 146 may conflict with each other.

codeIssues: PORT_MISMATCH: api.ts uses port 8086 (line 8) while ApiConfig.tsx uses port 8085 (lines 19, 58) causing network connectivity failures
DUPLICATE_JWT_CALLS: JWT token generation called multiple times in useEffect auto-configuration without proper state management
GENERIC_ERROR_HANDLING: Line 163 in ApiConfig.tsx catches all errors with generic 'Failed to configure API' message, hiding actual root cause
INCONSISTENT_URL_DETECTION: URL detection logic duplicated between api.ts and ApiConfig.tsx with different port mappings
STATE_SYNC_ISSUES: Global apiConfig variable in api.ts may not sync properly with React component state in ApiConfig.tsx
NETWORK_TIMEOUT: api.ts has 30s timeout (line 55) but JWT generation endpoints may have different timeout requirements
MISSING_ERROR_BOUNDARIES: No error boundaries around API configuration component to catch and display configuration errors gracefully
criticalFindings: PRIMARY_ISSUE: Port mismatch between api.ts (8086) and ApiConfig.tsx (8085) prevents successful API calls
SECONDARY_ISSUE: Generic error handling masks specific failure reasons like network errors, auth failures, or invalid responses
TERTIARY_ISSUE: Multiple JWT generation attempts without proper async coordination could cause configuration state corruption
